T: › to use a needle and syringe (= small tube) to put a liquid such as a drug into a person's body
› to introduce something new that is necessary or helpful to a situation or process

example: Phil's a diabetic and has to inject himself with insulin every day.
菲爾患有糖尿病，每天都要替自己注射胰島素。
A large amount of money will have to be injected into the company if it is to survive.
如果要挽救這家公司就必須注入大量資金。
I tried to inject a little humour into the meeting.
我試圖給會議增添一點幽默氣氛。

C or U: C2 the act of putting a liquid, especially a drug, into a person's body using a needle and a syringe (= small tube)
C2 the introduction of something new that is necessary or helpful to a situation or process

example: Daily insulin injections are necessary for some diabetics.
有些糖尿病患者必須每日注射胰島素。
This steroid is sometimes given by injection.
這種類固醇有時透過注射注入體內。
A cash injection of £20 million will be used to improve the health service.
2000萬英鎊將被投入用於改善醫療服務。
an injection of humour/excitement
增添幽默／刺激

NONE: › a process used for making plastic objects, in which melted plastic is forced into metal shapes and left until it is hard
不明智的；缺乏判斷力的

example: an injudicious remark
不明智的言論
Synonym
unwise

NONE: › an official order given by a law court, usually to stop someone from doing something

example: [ + to infinitive ] The court has issued an injunction to prevent the airline from increasing its prices.
法院頒布禁令不准航空公司加價。
[ + -ing verb ] She is seeking an injunction banning the newspaper from publishing the photographs.
她正在爭取獲得禁令，禁止報紙刊登這些照片。

NONE: B1 to hurt or cause physical harm to a person or animal

example: A bomb exploded at the embassy, injuring several people.
一枚炸彈在大使館爆炸，造成數人受傷。
She fell and injured her shoulder.
她摔傷了肩膀。
He was badly injured in the crash.
他在車禍中受了重傷。
He claimed that working too hard was injuring his health.
他聲稱工作過度損害了他的健康。

NONE: › If your feelings are injured, someone has offended or upset you.
› people who are injured, considered as a group

example: She was told to stay in bed to rest her injured back.
她被告知要臥床休息來養背傷。
It's nothing more than injured pride.
只是尊嚴受損了，沒有甚麼大不了。
The injured were taken to several nearby hospitals.
傷者被送到附近幾家醫院。
Too much alcohol is injurious to your health.
飲酒過量有害健康。

NONE: B2 physical harm or damage to someone's body caused by an accident or an attack

example: a head/back/knee injury
頭部／背部／膝蓋受傷
Several train passengers received/sustained serious injuries in the crash.
在這次火車撞車事故中幾名乘客受了重傷。
Injuries to the spine are common among these workers.
脊椎受傷在這些工人中是很普遍的。
They were lucky to escape (without) injury.
他們很幸運，沒有受傷。

NONE: › a period of time added to the end of a sports game because play was stopped during the game to take care of players who were hurt
C1 (an example of) a situation in which there is no fairness and justice

example: The sight of people suffering arouses a deep sense of injustice in her.
看到人們身陷苦難，她深感世道不公。
They were aware of the injustices of the system.
他們知道這種體制的不公正之處。
